origin: Two @mention failures same session (Ethan Mollick TAG 1, Howard Yu TAG 2): plain text posted silently after picker failed. Root causes: wrong name spelling ('Howard Hyu' → 'Howard Yu') and execCommand bypass. Three violations across two sessions before codification.
description: Before posting any LinkedIn tagging campaign comment: (1) verify exact LinkedIn display name from people file, (2) attempt @mention picker via type_text, (3) if picker returns nothing — STOP and ask human for profile URL. Never fall back to plain text silently.
gates: name_verified: confirmed exact LinkedIn display name before touching picker
picker_not_found → human_confirmed_fallback: ask human before posting plain text
applies_to: LinkedIn tagging campaign comments (TAGs 1-5 and any future campaigns)
Any comment on a LinkedIn post that requires @mentioning a specific person
litmus: Run HOW.py with person/name_verified/mention_picker_attempted/mention_picker_result — exit 0 = safe to post, exit 1 = blocked with remediation
